children: Joseph Baratta, a Director, reported sales of Blackstone common stock on 2026-09-18. The filings show two direct sales with weighted average prices of $123.35 and $124.13 per share, respectively. The total proceeds from the sales were $12,380,048. After the reported transactions, Baratta directly owned 771,599 shares of common stock. The filer provided footnotes stating the reported prices are weighted averages for multiple trades and that full breakdowns by price are available upon request.
